title: GitHub API User Info Fetcher
description: Fetch and display a GitHub user's public information using the GitHub API and `requests`.
problemStatement: Write a script `github_user.py` that takes a GitHub username (hardcode 'octocat' for testing) and retrieves their public profile info from `https://api.github.com/users/<username>`. Display: login name, name, public repos count, followers count, and their bio. If the user is not found (404), print 'User not found'. Handle network errors gracefully. Use `requests.get()` and parse JSON.
hints: Access fields: data['login'], data.get('name'), data['public_repos'], etc.
expectedOutput:
User: octocat
Name: The Octocat
Repos: 8
Followers: 1234
Bio: ...
solutionCode:
import requests

username = 'octocat'
url = f'https://api.github.com/users/{username}'

try:
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
    if resp.status_code == 200:
        data = resp.json()
        print(f"Login: {data['login']}")
        print(f"Name: {data.get('name', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"Public Repos: {data['public_repos']}")
        print(f"Followers: {data['followers']}")
        print(f"Bio: {data.get('bio', '')}")
    elif resp.status_code == 404:
        print("User not found")
    else:
        print(f"Unexpected status: {resp.status_code}")
except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
    print(f"Request failed: {e}")
